ruby._note: UPDATE 2026-11-22: 4.0.10 is the newest 4.0 on ruby-lang.org (released 2026-11-18; index.txt sha256 and the release announcement; the tarball downloaded 2026-11-22 hashes to it). It replaces 4.0.9 for GHSA-34m4-m9fh-gqp5, GHSA-7x2q-68qv-6p8x, GHSA-3p8q-wmhx-vm2w (critical), CVE-2026-132825 and GHSA-87fm-7w84-j2px, GHSA-wpqw-5qxg-m68r, GHSA-7whj-cfh7-xgm4 (high): seven Regexp and String case-conversion bugs, some with public PoCs for remote code execution, fixed in 4.0.10, 3.4.13 and 3.3.14 (ruby-lang.org advisory, 2026-11-18). Earlier notes below were written for 4.0.9 and name it as it was then. Gemfile: ruby '>= 3.3.0', '< 4.1.0'; upstream's image uses 4.0.9 since v4.7.4 (4.0.6 before). 4.0.9 is the newest 4.0 on ruby-lang.org (index.txt sha256, 2026-10-28). --with-jemalloc links jemalloc into Ruby, which upstream's image does with patchelf; --enable-yjit needs rustc at build time (RUBY_YJIT_ENABLE=1 as upstream). gem_updates: Ruby 4.0.9's default json is 2.18.0 (/usr/local/lib/ruby/gems/4.0.0/specifications/default/json-2.18.0.gemspec in chain 806's image), inside GHSA-3m6g-2423-7cp3 / CVE-2026-33210 (high, fixed 2.19.2), which chain 806's verdict listed; the app itself loads the json 2.21.2 Mastodon v4.7.4's Gemfile.lock locks (vendor/bundle). gem_updates replaces Ruby's copy with that same 2.21.2, so the image carries one json (openproject's fix on the same Ruby).

node_dist._note: Node 24, upstream's NODE_MAJOR_VERSION; nodejs.org's newest 24.x (scripts/node-pin.py). package.json: engines node >= 22, packageManager yarn@4.18.1 (corepack).

source._npm_floors_note: The streaming server runs on the production node_modules the asset build leaves (source.node_runtime), so its npm packages ship and are scanned. The floors go into the root package.json as Yarn resolutions before the asset build (gen_dockerfile npm_override_lines), so both `yarn workspaces focus` runs resolve them (it does not install frozen), and the vendor stage then checks every copy in the vendored tree is at its floor. All four are in-range raises of transitive dependencies (no declared range is crossed). OSV lists no advisory against any of the four fixed releases (2026-11-01).
source._asset_packages_note: Rails loads libvips (ruby-vips, through FFI) when it boots, also for assets:precompile; upstream's precompiler stage copies its libvips in. Here Ubuntu's libvips (8.15, above Mastodon's 8.13 minimum) is installed in the online asset stage only; the image runs the libvips 8.18.7 the offline build compiles.
asset_cmds: rm -rf node_modules && yarn workspaces focus --production @mastodon/streaming && test -d node_modules/ws && rm -rf tmp/cache
source._asset_note: Upstream's precompiler stage, then upstream's streaming/Dockerfile install: node_modules ends up holding only the streaming server's production dependencies, which the runtime's node runs.
source._app_prune_note: Upstream's build output only (the defaults without node_modules, which holds the streaming server's production dependencies): no upstream file is removed.
offline_build_cmds: mkdir -p /tmp/vips && tar -xJf /downloads/vips-8.18.7.tar.xz -C /tmp/vips --strip-components 1 --no-same-owner && cd /tmp/vips && meson setup build --prefix /usr/local --libdir=lib -Ddeprecated=false -Dintrospection=disabled -Dmodules=disabled -Dexamples=false && ninja -C build && ninja -C build install && cd / && rm -rf /tmp/vips

mkdir -p /tmp/ffmpeg && tar -xJf /downloads/ffmpeg-9.1.tar.xz -C /tmp/ffmpeg --strip-components 1 --no-same-owner && cd /tmp/ffmpeg && ./configure --prefix=/usr/local --toolchain=hardened --disable-debug --disable-devices --disable-doc --disable-ffplay --disable-network --disable-static --enable-ffmpeg --enable-ffprobe --enable-gpl --enable-libdav1d --enable-libmp3lame --enable-libopus --enable-libsnappy --enable-libvorbis --enable-libvpx --enable-libwebp --enable-libx264 --enable-libx265 --enable-shared --enable-version3 && make -j"$(nproc)" && make install && cd / && rm -rf /tmp/ffmpeg
ldconfig && vips -v && ffmpeg -version | head -1 && ffprobe -version | head -1
source._offline_build_note: libvips and FFmpeg with upstream's own options (Dockerfile stages libvips and ffmpeg), installed into /usr/local, which the runtime receives with Ruby (the headers stay behind).
